title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Following the escalation of conflict in Sudan in April 2023, Concern adapted its programming to respond to the needs of those affected by and displaced by the violence. This programme aims to provide for the essential and immediate needs of the population with non-Food Items or cash transfers. It also provides health and nutrition services to displaced and host communities working with local government health facilities. The programme provides for critical antenatal care services and implements the Community Management of Acute Malnutrition approach which involves the screening of ‬children and pregnant and lactating women for malnutrition, and their referral to outpatient nutrition services. The programme also delivers psychosocial support services.. This element of the programme aims to improve the provision of essential primary health and nutrition services by supporting health care facilities and through the provision of behaviour change communication on relevant maternal infant and young child feeding and caring, adapted to the priorities in the current emergency
